AWS_PROFILE=deploy-admin python3 -u - <<'PY' > deploy38.txt 2>&1
import gzip, hashlib, io, json, tarfile, urllib.request
import boto3
REPO = "eyecloud-fargate-runner"
BASE_TAG = "mott-lane-37"
NEW_TAG = "mott-lane-38"
FILE_PATH = "opt/cvc-booking-gateway/bland_gateway.py"
FIXED = "/home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workEve/gw-latest-first-builder/bland_gateway_fixed.py"
ecr = boto3.client("ecr", region_name="us-east-1")
ecs = boto3.client("ecs", region_name="us-east-1")
manifest = json.loads(ecr.batch_get_image(repositoryName=REPO, imageIds=[{"imageTag": BASE_TAG}])["images"][0]["imageManifest"])
if "manifests" in manifest:
    e = next(m for m in manifest["manifests"] if m.get("platform", {}).get("architecture") in ("amd64", "x86_64"))
    manifest = json.loads(ecr.batch_get_image(repositoryName=REPO, imageIds=[{"imageDigest": e["digest"]}])["images"][0]["imageManifest"])
config = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(ecr.get_download_url_for_layer(repositoryName=REPO, layerDigest=manifest["config"]["digest"])["downloadUrl"], timeout=120).read())
body = open(FIXED, "rb").read()
buf = io.BytesIO()
tar = tarfile.open(fileobj=buf, mode="w")
info = tarfile.TarInfo(name=FILE_PATH)
info.size = len(body)
info.mode = 0o644
info.mtime = 0
tar.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(body))
tar.close()
raw_tar = buf.getvalue()
diff_id = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(raw_tar).hexdigest()
gz = io.BytesIO()
with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=gz, mode="wb", mtime=0) as g:
    g.write(raw_tar)
blob = gz.getvalue()
layer_digest = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()
config["rootfs"]["diff_ids"].append(diff_id)
config.setdefault("history", []).append({"created": "2026-08-04T15:00:00Z", "created_by": "mott-lane-38 latest-first/anchor ordering (ringer fable-chief)", "comment": "single-file overlay"})
cfg_bytes = json.dumps(config).encode()
cfg_digest = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(cfg_bytes).hexdigest()
for data, digest in ((blob, layer_digest), (cfg_bytes, cfg_digest)):
    avail = ecr.batch_check_layer_availability(repositoryName=REPO, layerDigests=[digest])
    if (avail.get("layers") or [{}])[0].get("layerAvailability") == "AVAILABLE":
        print("LAYER_EXISTS %s" % digest[:19])
        continue
    try:
        up = ecr.initiate_layer_upload(repositoryName=REPO)
        ecr.upload_layer_part(repositoryName=REPO, uploadId=up["uploadId"], partFirstByte=0, partLastByte=len(data) - 1, layerPartBlob=data)
        ecr.complete_layer_upload(repositoryName=REPO, uploadId=up["uploadId"], layerDigests=[digest])
    except ecr.exceptions.LayerAlreadyExistsException:
        print("LAYER_RACE_OK %s" % digest[:19])
manifest["layers"].append({"mediaType": manifest["layers"][-1]["mediaType"], "size": len(blob), "digest": layer_digest})
manifest["config"] = {"mediaType": manifest["config"]["mediaType"], "size": len(cfg_bytes), "digest": cfg_digest}
try:
    ecr.put_image(repositoryName=REPO, imageManifest=json.dumps(manifest), imageTag=NEW_TAG)
    print("PUSHED %s" % NEW_TAG)
except ecr.exceptions.ImageAlreadyExistsException:
    print("PUSHED %s (already existed with identical digest - deterministic build)" % NEW_TAG)
m2 = json.loads(ecr.batch_get_image(repositoryName=REPO, imageIds=[{"imageTag": NEW_TAG}])["images"][0]["imageManifest"])
if "manifests" in m2:
    e2 = next(x for x in m2["manifests"] if x.get("platform", {}).get("architecture") in ("amd64", "x86_64"))
    m2 = json.loads(ecr.batch_get_image(repositoryName=REPO, imageIds=[{"imageDigest": e2["digest"]}])["images"][0]["imageManifest"])
last = m2["layers"][-1]
got = tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(gzip.decompress(urllib.request.urlopen(ecr.get_download_url_for_layer(repositoryName=REPO, layerDigest=last["digest"])["downloadUrl"], timeout=300).read()))).extractfile(FILE_PATH).read()
assert got == body, "byte verification failed"
print("VERIFY_IDENTICAL=1")
td = ecs.describe_task_definition(taskDefinition="mott-booking-gateway:52")["taskDefinition"]
for k in ("taskDefinitionArn", "revision", "status", "requiresAttributes", "compatibilities", "registeredAt", "registeredBy", "deregisteredAt"):
    td.pop(k, None)
img = td["containerDefinitions"][0]["image"]
assert img.endswith(":mott-lane-37"), img
td["containerDefinitions"][0]["image"] = img.replace(":mott-lane-37", ":mott-lane-38")
rev = ecs.register_task_definition(**td)["taskDefinition"]["revision"]
print("NEW_REVISION=%d" % rev)
ecs.update_service(cluster="stack2", service="mott-booking-gateway", taskDefinition="mott-booking-gateway:%d" % rev)
ecs.get_waiter("services_stable").wait(cluster="stack2", services=["mott-booking-gateway"], WaiterConfig={"Delay": 15, "MaxAttempts": 60})
svc = ecs.describe_services(cluster="stack2", services=["mott-booking-gateway"])["services"][0]
print("STABLE taskdef=%s running=%d" % (svc["taskDefinition"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1], svc["runningCount"]))
print("ROLLBACK_CMD=aws ecs update-service --cluster stack2 --service mott-booking-gateway --task-definition mott-booking-gateway:52")
print("DEPLOY_DONE")
PY
rc=$?; cat deploy38.txt; exit $rc
tasks.check:
grep -q 'DEPLOY_DONE' deploy38.txt || { echo 'FAIL: deploy incomplete:'; tail -6 deploy38.txt; exit 1; }; grep -q 'VERIFY_IDENTICAL=1' deploy38.txt || { echo 'FAIL: byte verification missing'; exit 1; }; grep -qE 'STABLE taskdef=mott-booking-gateway:[0-9]+ running=[1-9]' deploy38.txt || { echo 'FAIL: not stable'; exit 1; }; python3 /home/ankit114/repos/paid_ads_mybcat/scripts/secret_exec.py --secret-env GW_TOKEN=conductor/agents/bland-mott/api-key -- python3 -c "import json,os,urllib.request; auth=os.environ['GW_TOKEN'].strip(); auth=auth if auth.lower().startswith('bearer') else 'Bearer '+auth;
import urllib.request as u
def avail(body):
    req=u.Request('https://mott-booking-gw.mail.mybcat.com/availability', data=json.dumps(body).encode(), method='POST', headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','User-Agent':'mybcat-cli','Authorization':auth})
    with u.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as r: return (json.loads(r.read().decode() or '{}').get('result') or {}).get('slots') or []
base={'store':'711','from':'thursday','to':'thursday','slot_minutes':'15','after':'none','before':'none','time_pref':'none'}
d=avail(base); l=avail({**base,'time_pref':'latest'})
assert d and l, 'no slots returned'
assert d[0]['start']!=l[0]['start'], 'latest mode returned same first slot as default'
assert l[0]['start']>d[0]['start'], 'latest first slot not later than default first slot'
print('LIVE_LATEST_OK default_first=%s latest_first=%s' % (d[0]['start'], l[0]['start']))" || { echo 'FAIL: live latest-mode probe failed'; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: lane-38 deployed, byte-verified, live latest-mode proven; $(grep -m1 'STABLE' deploy38.txt)"
